This season, I will plant hybrid maize seed on my 0.35-hectare plot because the government subsidy program helps me get improved varieties and one bag of fertilizer. I have some cattle manure from our animals, so I will spread that first before planting, and then I will apply one bag of NPK fertilizer to give the maize a boost because the soil here in Dowa is getting tired. I cannot afford pesticides or herbicides, so my children and I will weed the field by hand when the rains come, and I will hire a few days of labor from the neighboring village to help with the second weeding and harvesting since my husband works away sometimes. We depend on the rains completely, so I will not irrigate; I just pray the rains are good this year.
